maintenance: Every fork change adds or updates an entry here in the same commit: new files go in key_paths, edited upstream-owned files go in touches_upstream_files, and the commit sha goes in commits. After each upstream sync update last_upstream_sync.

customizations.title: Dart (dartai.com) task provider: main process, RPC, shared contract, renderer runtime client and store
customizations.summary: Adds Dart as a fourth task source next to GitHub, Linear and Jira. The main process holds a sealed API token and talks to the Dart API; the same capability is exposed over RPC (capability dart.provider.v1) so remote Orca servers work, and the renderer reads it through a runtime client and a store slice. The shared task-provider, workspace-attachment and linked-item contracts were widened to carry 'dart'.
customizations.sync_notes: Largest conflict surface. src/shared/task-providers.ts, task-provider-identity.ts, workspace-attachment*.ts, workspace-linked-item*.ts, workspace-reference-identity.ts and rpc-params-catalog.generated.ts (regenerate, do not hand-merge) are shared provider unions that upstream edits when it changes Jira or Linear. register-core-handlers.ts gained registerDartHandlers() and lost the relaunch-dismissal helper (see relaunch-dismissal-extraction). runtime-edge-command-controller.ts binds RuntimeDartCommands. orcad-plaintext-credential-migration.ts lists the Dart token envelope. create-worktree.ts and folder-workspace-mutations.ts replaced Jira-only remote capability checks with assertLinkedTaskProviderCapabilities. config/focus-setting-read-baseline.txt must keep upstream sort order. After a sync, re-run the Dart tests plus the RPC catalog generator.
known_gaps: Tasks page is read-and-link only: creating, updating and commenting on Dart tasks is done via the orca dart CLI, not the UI.
No Dart support on mobile (see dart-mobile-deferral).

customizations.title: Dart renderer UI: settings card, Tasks page, workspace linking, English copy
customizations.summary: The user-facing side of Dart: a connect dialog and Integrations card, a Dart source on the Tasks page (list, filters, detail), workspace linking by task or by pasted URL, sidebar badges and reference details, automation source labels, and the English strings. Only en.json is updated; other locales are not touched.
customizations.sync_notes: Provider switches in task-page hooks (use-task-page-*.ts, SourceBar.tsx, ProviderFilters.tsx, Content.tsx), sidebar attachment code, settings panes and automation source labels each gained a dart branch; upstream edits to Jira/Linear in those files usually conflict. en.json and en-runtime-required.json are large append-style diffs: take upstream, then re-add the dart keys. worktree-nav-view-history-replay.ts was refactored (CLEARED_TASK_DETAILS) to also clear openDartTask/openDartSourceContext. Check any new switch over task providers upstream adds for a missing dart case.
known_gaps: Only the English locale has Dart strings.
Task page cannot create or edit tasks.

customizations.title: orca dart CLI and bundled orca-dart agent skill
customizations.summary: Adds the orca dart command group (status, config, list, get, comment list/add, create, update) and the bundled orca-dart skill so agents can read a Dart task, move its status and post a completion comment. Includes a shared UNVERIFIED_WRITE_OUTCOME_CODES list also used by the Jira write handler, and a settings row that installs the skill.
customizations.sync_notes: resources/skills/current-manifest.json and released-digests.json are generated/hash files: on conflict take upstream and regenerate with the repo skill scripts rather than hand-merging. Also check src/cli/specs/index.ts, handler-group-manifest.ts, bundled-skill-guides.ts and bundled-skill-sources.ts (registration lists). jira-write.ts now imports the shared outcome-code list. linear-agent-skill-install-cta.tsx was reduced to use bundled-agent-skill-install-row.tsx; upstream edits to the Linear CTA must be re-applied there.
known_gaps: Writes are sent once and never retried; a dropped connection reports dart_write_unverified.

customizations.title: Mobile: hide Dart source and guard Linear fallthroughs
customizations.summary: The mobile app does not support Dart yet. The deferred provider is hidden from the source picker, the task list shows a deferred message, and workspace creation reports a deferred-source error instead of falling through to the Linear path.
customizations.sync_notes: Mobile task files switch on provider with Linear as the implicit default; any new upstream provider branch there must keep the Dart guard. mobile-tasks-list-surface.tsx also had a merge format fix in c1cc7e3b368.
known_gaps: Mobile has no Dart browse, link or create. Planned as a later phase (unconfirmed in repo).

customizations.title: Dart docs page and links
customizations.summary: Docs page for connecting Dart, browsing and linking tasks, remote servers, the orca dart CLI and the orca-dart skill, plus one-line links from Settings and Worktrees docs.
customizations.sync_notes: review/meta.json is a page-order list; keep the dart entry when upstream adds pages.

customizations.title: Block Stably updates on fork builds
customizations.summary: A build whose version ends in local.<timestamp>.<commit> never contacts the Stably update feed, including the local-build picker. Menu checks answer "This is a fork build; updates come from the rebuild job". Prevents a Stably release from overwriting the fork.
customizations.sync_notes: updater-menu-checks.ts and updater-setup.ts moved to src/main/updater/lifecycle/ upstream; if upstream reshuffles the updater again, re-apply isForkBuild() checks. config/fork/README.md still names the old paths src/main/updater.* and src/main/updater/updater-menu-checks.ts (stale after the move).
known_gaps: Fork-build detection depends on the version suffix produced by config/scripts/build-mac-local.mjs.

customizations.title: Nightly fork rebuild and install scripts (config/fork)
customizations.summary: Scripts and a launchd template that fast-forward the fork, merge upstream/main, run the Dart gates, build the fork, push and notify; a separate install command swaps the new app in (Mac) or the /opt/Orca server install with rollback. All files are fork-added; no upstream file is edited.
customizations.sync_notes: No conflicts expected; config/fork/ does not exist upstream.

customizations.title: Sync fix-up: relaunch dismissal helper extracted
customizations.summary: closeNotificationDismissalsBeforeRelaunch was moved out of register-core-handlers.ts into relaunch-dismissal-close.ts in the post-merge format commits. Purpose is not stated in the commit messages; likely to keep register-core-handlers.ts within its size limit after registerDartHandlers() was added (inferred, unverified).
customizations.sync_notes: If upstream edits closeNotificationDismissalsBeforeRelaunch in register-core-handlers.ts, port the change into relaunch-dismissal-close.ts. Consider whether the extraction is still needed; reverting avoids the hotspot.

customizations.title: Stable code-signing identity for fork Mac builds
customizations.summary: Every fork Mac build is signed with one self-signed certificate (Orca Fork Signing), so macOS Local Network and privacy grants for the app, its helpers and Orca Computer Use.app survive rebuilds. Unsigned local builds carry a bundle seal macOS rejects, which silently blocked the app from paired LAN servers (remote_runtime_unavailable).
customizations.sync_notes: No conflicts expected; config/fork/ does not exist upstream.
known_gaps: CI builds (plan task 2) must import the ORCA_FORK_MAC_CERT secret and sign before zipping or packaging a dmg.
The certificate is self-signed: Gatekeeper still warns on a downloaded app; an Apple Developer ID would remove that.
Only the installed .app is signed; dist dmg/zip/latest-mac.yml are written before signing.
